About the Scholarship

CCD-STeDe links climate-change science with sustainable territorial development across a consortium spanning Italy, Ecuador, Portugal, Burkina Faso and South Africa. The first call for the 2026/2027 academic year closed on 15 February 2026, and the next round is expected on a similar February timeline.

HostCCD-STeDe Consortium (University of Padua)
LocationPadua (multi-country mobility), Italy
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline15 February 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

CCD-STeDe links climate-change science with sustainable territorial development across a consortium spanning Italy, Ecuador, Portugal, Burkina Faso and South Africa. The first call for the 2026/2027 academic year closed on 15 February 2026, and the next round is expected on a similar February timeline.

Programme Highlights

  • Genuinely global consortium with mobility inside and outside Europe
  • February first-call deadline pattern for scholarship consideration
  • Multilingual tracks (English plus Spanish/French/Portuguese pathways)
  • Careers in climate adaptation, territorial planning and development cooperation

Who Should Apply

Graduates in environmental science, geography, development studies, agriculture and related fields; fieldwork readiness matters in this programme.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the CCD-STeDe site for the new call and submit through the application form during the first-call window. Key deadline information: 15 February 2027 (expected — the 2026/2027 first call closed 15 February 2026).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About CCD-STeDe Consortium (University of Padua)

The CCD-STeDe consortium is coordinated from the University of Padua and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Climate Change and Diversity: Sustainable Territorial Development with partners in Europe, Latin America and Africa.

Official website: https://ccd-stede.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
